| # RC40 CANopen communication objects {#rc40-canopen-communication-objects-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                         |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 The object dictionary contains all essential data which is necessary for configuring, parameterizing and operating a CANopen instance. All parameters of the object dictionary can be accessed via SDO protocol. The object dictionary represents an interface for communicating with the external devices. The structure of the object dictionary and of the individual objects themselves are described in CiA specifications CiA 301, CiA 304 etc.

 

CANopen communication parameters supported by CANopen library:

 

  --------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------

  [0x1002](object-0x1002-manufacturer-sta.html){.topiclink}             Manufacturer Status Register                                     RO

  [0x1005](object-0x1005-cob-id-sync-mess.html){.topiclink}             COB-ID SYNC message                                              RW
